versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated medical model configuration: API endpoint remains the same, but the model is now set to u2-med (previously u1-insuremed).
- No changes to skill functionality or inputs/outputs.

Initial release of med-pharma-literature-analysis skill for pharmaceutical R&D literature analysis.

- Provides structured analysis of medical literature for pharmaceutical R&D and medical affairs management.
- References the evidence synthesis section of the Literature Review skill, including theme matching, information structuring, key findings extraction, evidence summary, and research gap identification.
- Supports multi-format input: JSON, CSV/XLS(X), TXT/MD, PDF/DOC/DOCX, image OCR.
- Requires API-based semantic analysis via an internal medical model; no local analysis mode.
- Outputs standardized UTF-8 JSON with both structured data and natural language summary.
